verdict.rationale: The evidence only says generically that Zoho Books can 'create financial reports' and 'pull reports'. It also offers custom reports with adjustable relative date ranges, which hints at on-demand period selection. None of the evidence names the three core statements. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of P&L, balance sheet and cash-flow statement reports, evidence of arbitrary-period selection for those statements, and independent or hands-on corroboration of their accuracy.
